---
title: "GLM-AED aed_alum Stress Tests"
format: html
eval: true
execute:
  cache: true
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    # Bust every chunk's cache whenever the sourced helper functions or the
    # case's namelist templates change, even though the chunk's own code
    # text didn't — otherwise a cached chunk would keep serving simulation
    # results from before the fix.
    cache.extra: !expr tools::md5sum(c(
      "R/aed_alum_stress_test_helpers.R",
      "LakeRotorua/aed/aed_original.nml",
      "LakeRotorua/glm4_original.nml"))
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(AEME)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)

glm_exec <- list.files(pattern = "*.exe", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
glm_exec <- normalizePath(glm_exec)
options("AEME.glm_exec" = glm_exec)

aed_file <- "LakeRotorua/aed/aed_original.nml"
aed      <- AEME::read_nml(aed_file)

# use only necessaary models for testing
aed_models <- c("aed_sedflux", "aed_oxygen", "aed_carbon", "aed_phosphorus", "aed_alum")
aed$aed_models$models <- aed_models

glm_file <- "LakeRotorua/glm4_original.nml"
glm_def <- AEME::read_nml(glm_file)
glm_def$inflow$num_inflows <- 0

# A minimal FRP-maintenance inflow — just enough to hold FRP near K_P
# Used only for kinetic rate tests (2.2, 2.3, 2.5) and steady-state (5.3)
INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP  <- 0.3    # mmol/m³ — matches K_P
INFLOW_KINETIC_FLOW <- 3   # m³/s — small relative to lake volume

# The realistic scenario inflow — used for sections 7 and 9
INFLOW_SCENARIO_FRP  <- 0.5   # mmol/m³ — realistic stream concentration
INFLOW_SCENARIO_FLOW <- 1.9 # m³/s — realistic Utuhina-scale flow

# Elevated starting FRP (via init_wq) for tests whose premise is "ample/high
# FRP available" from t=0 — an inflow alone takes time to build FRP up from
# the case's near-zero default, which left these effectively untested at
# t=0. Used by 2.1, 6.1, 6.2, 7.2, 7.3, 8.1.
INIT_FRP_HIGH <- 50.0   # mmol/m³ — well above K_P (0.3), for saturation/high-FRP scenarios


# ── Default aed_alum namelist ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
nml_def_txt <- "
&aed_alum
   ala_initial     = 0.0
   alp_initial     = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial = 0.0
   frp_variable    = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w             = 0.5
   k_s             = 0.1
   K_P             = 0.3
   w_ala           = 5.0
   k_age_w         = 0.0998
   k_age_s         = 0.0998
   k_bur           = 0.01
   simResuspension = .false.
   k_res           = 0.0
   ads_use_pH      = .false.
   pH_variable     = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt          = 6.0
   sigma_pH        = 1.0
   S_ala           = 0.0
   diag_level      = 10
/
"
tmp_nml_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".nml")
writeLines(nml_def_txt, tmp_nml_file)
def_alum_nml <- AEME::read_nml(tmp_nml_file)

aed_carbon_nml <- "
! aed_carbon: dissolved inorganic carbon, pH/alkalinity, and methane dynamics
&aed_carbon
   dic_initial         = 1000            !# Initial dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) concentration (mmol C/m3)
   pH_initial          = 7.5             !# Initial pH
   ch4_initial         = 4.5             !# Initial methane (CH4) concentration (mmol C/m3)
   ionic               = 0               !# Ionic strength, for carbonate speciation (mol/L)
   Rch4ox              = 0.1E-001        !# Maximum methane oxidation rate (/day)
   Kch4ox              = 0.1E-001        !# Half-saturation oxygen concentration for methane oxidation (mmol O2/m3)
   vTch4ox             = 1.05            !# Arrhenius temperature multiplier for methane oxidation
!  methane_reactant_variable= ''              !# Link to aed_oxygen; required oxygen source for methane oxidation (unset by default)
   simCH4              = .false.         !# Enable methane (CH4) simulation
   Fsed_dic            = 0               !# Sediment DIC flux (mmol C/m2/day)
   Ksed_dic            = 30              !# Half-saturation oxygen concentration for the sediment DIC flux (mmol O2/m3)
   theta_sed_dic       = 1               !# Arrhenius temperature multiplier for sediment DIC flux
!  Fsed_dic_variable   = ''              !# Link to aed_sedflux for a spatially/temporally varying Fsed_dic (unset by default)
   Fsed_ch4            = 0               !# Sediment methane flux (mmol C/m2/day)
   Ksed_ch4            = 30              !# Half-saturation oxygen concentration for the sediment methane flux (mmol O2/m3)
   theta_sed_ch4       = 1               !# Arrhenius temperature multiplier for sediment methane flux
!  Fsed_ch4_variable   = ''              !# Link to aed_sedflux for a spatially/temporally varying Fsed_ch4 (unset by default)
   atm_co2             = 0.367E-003      !# Atmospheric CO2 partial pressure (atm)
   atm_ch4             = 0.176E-005      !# Atmospheric CH4 partial pressure (atm)
   co2_piston_model    = 1               !# Atmospheric CO2 exchange piston velocity model
   ch4_piston_model    = 1               !# Atmospheric CH4 exchange piston velocity model
   co2_model           = 1               !# CO2/carbonate system model: 0=diagnostic pCO2 only, 1=full carbonate speciation
   alk_mode            = 1               !# Alkalinity handling mode
   ebb_model           = 0               !# Methane ebullition (bubbling) model: 0=off
   Fsed_ch4_ebb        = 0               !# Sediment methane ebullition flux (mmol C/m2/day)
!  Fsed_ebb_variable   = ''              !# Link to aed_sedflux for a spatially/temporally varying Fsed_ch4_ebb (unset by default)
   ch4_bub_aLL         = 42.95127        !# Methane ebullition bubble-size distribution parameter a
   ch4_bub_cLL         = 0.634           !# Methane ebullition bubble-size distribution parameter c
   ch4_bub_kLL         = -0.8247         !# Methane ebullition bubble-size distribution parameter k
   ch4_bub_disf1       = 0.7E-001        !# Methane bubble dissolution fraction, shallow
   ch4_bub_disf2       = 0.33            !# Methane bubble dissolution fraction, deep
   ch4_bub_disdp       = 20              !# Methane bubble dissolution reference depth (m)
   ch4_bub_ws          = 0               !# Methane bubble rise velocity (m/day) (currently unused)
   ch4_bub_tau0        = 1               !# Methane bubble formation timescale (currently unused)
   maxMPBProdn         = 40              !# Maximum microphytobenthos production rate (mmol C/m2/day) (currently unused)
   IkMPB               = 180             !# Microphytobenthos light sensitivity (currently unused)
   simExposed          = .false.         !# Enable dry/exposed-sediment carbon cycling (auto-enabled when dry_model>0)
   dry_model           = 0               !# Dry/exposed-sediment carbon model: 0=off
   theta_sed_dry       = 1               !# Arrhenius temperature multiplier for dry/exposed-sediment flux
   simStemCH4          = .false.         !# Enable the plant-stem methane transport pathway
   stem_model          = 0               !# Plant-stem methane transport model: 0=off
   theta_stm_ch4       = 1               !# Arrhenius temperature multiplier for stem methane transport
   Fstm_ch4            = 0               !# Stem methane transport flux (mmol C/m2/day)
!  vegetation_stem_density= ''              !# Link to the vegetation stem-density variable (requires stem_model=2) (unset by default)
   diag_level          = 10              !# Diagnostic output verbosity: 0=none, 1=basic, 2=flux rates, 3=other metrics, 10=all debug
!  Fstm_ch4_variable   = ''              !# Link to aed_sedflux for a spatially/temporally varying Fstm_ch4 (unset by default)
/
"
writeLines(aed_carbon_nml, con = tmp_nml_file)
def_carbon_nml <- AEME::read_nml(tmp_nml_file)

# ── Helper functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# write_inflow_glm(), set_outflow_glm(), run_test(), safe_run(), the output
# extraction helpers (get_var(), surface(), bottom(), col_mean(), col_sum(),
# wc_mass(), benthic_mass()) and check() live in R/aed_alum_stress_test_helpers.R
# — see that file for documentation. They rely on `aed`, `aed_models`,
# `def_alum_nml`, `def_carbon_nml` and `glm_def` (all defined above/below).
source("R/aed_alum_stress_test_helpers.R")

# ── Tolerances ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tol_abs <- 1e-6
tol_rel <- 1e-3

# ── Non-stopping check infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────
.test_results <- data.frame(
  id = character(), label = character(),
  status = character(), detail = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ── Shared plot theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
th <- theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))

pool_cols <- c(
  ALU_ala     = "#1f77b4", ALU_alp     = "#ff7f0e",
  ALU_ben_ala = "#2ca02c", ALU_ben_alp = "#d62728",
  PHS_frp     = "#9467bd", ALU_uptake_w = "#8c564b",
  ALU_uptake_s = "#e377c2", ALU_fpH     = "#7f7f7f",
  expected    = "black"
)

# set_outflow_glm(glm, enabled = FALSE)
dir.create("LakeRotorua/output/", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Setup complete.\n")
```

# `aed_alum` Stress Tests

Each section configures the `&aed_alum` namelist, runs GLM-AED, records pass/fail for every assertion, and plots the relevant output variables. The document **always renders to completion**; results are collected in the [Summary](#summary) at the end.

Output variables: `ALU_ala`, `ALU_alp`, `ALU_uptake_w`, `ALU_fpH`, `ALU_ben_ala`, `ALU_ben_alp`, `ALU_uptake_s`, `PHS_frp`

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Initialisation & Configuration

### 1.1 Null model — all rates zero

All pools initialised to non-zero values; every rate set to zero. **Expect:** all four pools remain exactly constant; all uptake diagnostics = 0; `ALU_fpH = 1.0` throughout.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 1.1</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 5.0
   alp_initial          = 2.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 3.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 1.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.0
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-1-1
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 5.0, alp_initial = 2.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 3.0, ben_alp_initial = 1.0,
    k_w = 0.0, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, k_res = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  alp      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  ben_ala  <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_ala_Z")
  ben_alp  <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_alp_Z")
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  uptake_s <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_s_Z")
  fpH      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_fpH")

  check("1.1a", "ALU_ala total constant (null model)", diff(range(ala)) / (mean(ala) + 1e-12) < 0.01)
  check("1.1b", "ALU_alp total constant (null model)", diff(range(alp)) / (mean(alp) + 1e-12) < 0.01)
  check("1.1c", "ALU_ben_ala constant (null model)", diff(range(ben_ala)) < tol_abs)
  check("1.1d", "ALU_ben_alp constant (null model)", diff(range(ben_alp)) < tol_abs)
  check("1.1e", "ALU_uptake_w = 0 (null model)",     all(abs(uptake_w)    < tol_abs))
  check("1.1f", "ALU_uptake_s = 0 (null model)",     all(abs(uptake_s)    < tol_abs))
  check("1.1g", "ALU_fpH = 1 (pH disabled)",         all(abs(fpH - 1.0)  < tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(ala)
  df_pools <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_ala = ala, ALU_alp = alp,
                         ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala, ALU_ben_alp = ben_alp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
  df_diag <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_uptake_w = uptake_w,
                        ALU_uptake_s = as.numeric(uptake_s), ALU_fpH = fpH) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  p1 <- ggplot(df_pools, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
    labs(title = "1.1 Pool concentrations (null model)",
         subtitle = "All should be flat horizontal lines",
         x = "Day", y = "Concentration (mmol/m³ or mmol/m²)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_diag, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
    labs(title = "1.1 Diagnostics (null model)",
         subtitle = "uptake_w and uptake_s = 0; fpH = 1",
         x = "Day", y = "Value") + th

  print(p1 / p2)
} else {
  for (id in c("1.1a","1.1b","1.1c","1.1d","1.1e","1.1f","1.1g"))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 1.2 No-dosing baseline — all pools start at zero

`S_ala = 0`, every initial pool = 0. **Expect:** nothing spontaneously appears; all outputs remain 0.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 1.2</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 0.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 5.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0998
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.01
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-1-2
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  # Pelagic vars: check column sum stays near zero (mixing shifts layers)
  for (v in c("ALU_uptake_w","ALU_ben_ala","ALU_ben_alp","ALU_uptake_s"))
    check(paste0("1.2-", v), paste(v, "= 0 (zero baseline)"),
          all(abs(get_var(out, v)) < tol_abs))
  # For pelagic pool sums, allow tiny mixing noise (< 0.1% of initial if non-zero)
  for (v in c("ALU_ala","ALU_alp"))
    check(paste0("1.2-", v), paste(v, "column-sum = 0 (zero baseline)"),
          max(abs(col_mean(out, v))) < tol_abs)

  day <- seq_along(col_mean(out, "ALU_ala"))
  df <- data.frame(
    day          = day,
    ALU_ala      = col_mean(out, "ALU_ala"),
    ALU_alp      = col_mean(out, "ALU_alp"),
    ALU_ben_ala  = col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_ala_Z"),
    ALU_ben_alp  = col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_alp_Z"),
    ALU_uptake_w = col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w"),
    ALU_uptake_s = col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_s_Z")
  ) |> pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
      labs(title = "1.2 Zero baseline — all pools",
           subtitle = "All lines should lie on y = 0",
           x = "Day", y = "Value") + th
  )
} else {
  check("1.2", "Zero baseline (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 1.3 pH modifier disabled — `ALU_fpH` always 1.0

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 1.3</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 10.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 5.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0998
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.01
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0

/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-1-3
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(aed_alum = list(ala_initial = 10.0, ads_use_pH = FALSE, S_ala = 0.0)))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  fpH <- col_mean(out, "ALU_fpH")
  check("1.3", "ALU_fpH = 1 when ads_use_pH = FALSE", all(abs(fpH - 1.0) < tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(fpH)
  print(
    ggplot(data.frame(day = day, fpH = fpH), aes(day, fpH)) +
      geom_line(colour = pool_cols["ALU_fpH"]) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
      ylim(0, 1.2) +
      labs(title = "1.3 ALU_fpH with pH modifier disabled",
           subtitle = "Should be flat at 1.0",
           x = "Day", y = "fpH (-)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("1.3", "pH disabled test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 1.4 Resuspension flag suppresses flux

`simResuspension = FALSE` with `k_res = 0.1`; no pelagic initial values. **Expect:** water-column `ALU_ala` and `ALU_alp` remain 0.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 1.4</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 0.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 10.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 5.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.0
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.1
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-1-4
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 10.0, ben_alp_initial = 5.0,
    k_w = 0.0, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0,
    simResuspension = FALSE, k_res = 0.1, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  ala     <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  alp     <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  ben_ala <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_ala_Z")
  ben_alp <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_alp_Z")

  # Mixing can redistribute a tiny amount; check surface layer stays 0
  ala_surf <- surface(out, "ALU_ala")
  check("1.4a", "ALU_ala surface = 0 (resuspension flag off)", all(abs(ala_surf) < tol_abs))
  check("1.4b", "ALU_alp = 0 (resuspension flag off)", all(abs(alp) < tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(ala)
  df <- data.frame(day = day,
                   ALU_ala = ala, ALU_alp = alp,
                   ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala, ALU_ben_alp = ben_alp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
      labs(title = "1.4 Resuspension flag off — pelagic pools",
           subtitle = "ALU_ala and ALU_alp must stay at 0; benthic pools unchanged",
           x = "Day", y = "Concentration") + th
  )
} else {
  check("1.4", "Resuspension flag test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

## 2. Water-Column Kinetics

### 2.1 Zero capacity → zero uptake

`ALU_ala = 0`; FRP elevated. **Expect:** `ALU_uptake_w = 0`; `ALU_alp` stays 0.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 2.1</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 0.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-2-1
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  alp      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  frp      <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")

  check("2.1a", "ALU_uptake_w = 0 when ala = 0", all(abs(uptake_w) < tol_abs))
  check("2.1b", "ALU_alp = 0 when ala = 0",      all(abs(alp)      < tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(uptake_w)
  df <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_uptake_w = uptake_w,
                   ALU_alp = alp, PHS_frp = frp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
      labs(title = "2.1 Zero capacity — uptake and alp",
           subtitle = "uptake_w and ALU_alp must be 0; FRP unchanged",
           x = "Day", y = "Value") + th
  )
} else {
  check("2.1", "Zero capacity test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 2.2 Michaelis-Menten half-maximum

FRP = K_P = 0.3; `ala` = 10; `k_w` = 0.5. **Expect:** `ALU_uptake_w ≈ 2.5 mmol/m³/d` at t = 0.

> Uses the kinetic maintenance inflow (`INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP = 0.3 mmol/m³`) to hold FRP near K_P. Check is evaluated at the first output timestep only.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 2.2</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 10.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-2-2
#| echo: false

# Kinetic inflow maintains FRP near K_P throughout
glm_22 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP, flow = INFLOW_KINETIC_FLOW, enabled = T)

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.1, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.0, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  ),
  aed_phosphorus = list(
    frp_initial = 0.3,
    ksed_frp = 0,                       # turn off sediment flux
    fsed_frp_variable = "",             # decouple from sediment flux
    phosphorus_reactant_variable = ""   # decouple from oxygen too
  )
),init_wq = list(PHS_frp = 0.3),
glm_nml = glm_22)

if (!is.null(out)) {
  uptake_w  <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  ala       <- out[["ALU_ala"]]
  frp       <- out[["PHS_frp"]]
  mm_theory_mat <- 0.5 * ala * frp / (0.3 + frp)  # Evaluate at t=0 only before FRP can drift; use actual frp[1] in formula
  mm_theory <- colMeans((mm_theory_mat))
  expected_half <- mm_theory[1]
  rel_err       <- abs(uptake_w[1] - expected_half) / (expected_half + 1e-12)

  check("2.2", "ALU_uptake_w ≈ half-max at FRP = K_P (t=0)",
        rel_err < 0.05,  # 5% tolerance at t=0
        sprintf("expected=%.4f observed=%.4f rel_err=%.4f",
                expected_half, uptake_w[1], rel_err))

  day <- seq_along(uptake_w)
  # Theoretical MM curve given actual FRP and ala at each timestep
  # mm_theory <- 0.5 * ala * frp / (0.3 + frp)

  df <- data.frame(day = day, observed = uptake_w, theoretical_MM = mm_theory) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed = "#1f77b4", theoretical_MM = "black")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(observed = "solid", theoretical_MM = "dashed")) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey70", linetype = "dotted") +
      annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(uptake_w, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
               label = sprintf("t=0: obs=%.3f\nexpected=%.3f", uptake_w[1], expected_half),
               hjust = 0, size = 3) +
      labs(title = "2.2 Michaelis-Menten half-maximum check",
           subtitle = "Observed uptake_w vs. MM theory; should overlap closely",
           x = "Day", y = "Uptake (mmol/m³/d)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("2.2", "Half-max test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 2.3 Mass conservation — FRP lost = `ALU_alp` gained

No settling, ageing, burial or dosing. Uses the kinetic maintenance inflow to keep FRP above zero throughout. **Expect:** `Δ(ALU_alp) + Δ(PHS_frp) ≈ 0` at every timestep; residual bounded by sediment flux contribution (tolerance relaxed to 5% of mean uptake rate).

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 2.3</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 20.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-2-3
#| echo: false

glm_23 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP, flow = INFLOW_KINETIC_FLOW)
out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 20.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.0, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_23, init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  frp_mass <- wc_mass(out, "PHS_frp")
  alp_mass <- wc_mass(out, "ALU_alp")
  residual  <- diff(frp_mass) + diff(alp_mass)
  max_resid <- max(abs(residual))
  # Tolerance: sediment flux adds FRP independently; allow 5% of mean uptake flux
  mean_uptake <- mean(abs(diff(alp_mass)), na.rm = TRUE)
  tol_mb <- max(tol_abs, 0.05 * mean_uptake)

  check("2.3", "Δ(FRP_mass) + Δ(ALU_alp_mass) ≈ 0 (water-col mass balance, mmol)",
        max_resid < tol_mb, sprintf("max residual = %.2e mmol  tol = %.2e", max_resid, tol_mb))

  day <- seq_along(frp_mass)
  # Keep concentration series for plot context
  frp <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  alp <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  df_conc <- data.frame(day = day, PHS_frp_mass = frp_mass, ALU_alp_mass = alp_mass,
                        total_mass = frp_mass + alp_mass) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  df_resid <- data.frame(day = day[-1], residual = residual)

  p1 <- ggplot(df_conc, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(PHS_frp_mass = pool_cols["PHS_frp"],
                                   ALU_alp_mass = pool_cols["ALU_alp"],
                                   total_mass   = "black")) +
    labs(title = "2.3 Water-column P mass balance (mmol)",
         subtitle = "FRP_mass + ALU_alp_mass (total) should be flat",
         x = "Day", y = "Mass (mmol)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_resid, aes(day, residual)) +
    geom_line(colour = "firebrick") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "2.3 Residual Δ(FRP_mass) + Δ(ALU_alp_mass)",
         subtitle = sprintf("Max = %.2e mmol  (should be ~0)", max_resid),
         x = "Day", y = "Residual (mmol)") + th

  print(p1 / p2)
} else {
  check("2.3", "Water-col mass balance (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 2.4 Ageing — exponential decay of capacity

Only `k_age_w` active; no FRP, no uptake, no settling. **Expect:** `ALU_ala(t) ≈ ala₀ × exp(−k_age_w × t)`; `ALU_alp` stays 0.

```{r}
#| label: test-2-4
#| echo: false

k_age_w_val <- 0.0998; ala0 <- 10.0

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = ala0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.0, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = k_age_w_val, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  alp      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  dt_days  <- if (!is.null(attr(out, "dt_days"))) attr(out, "dt_days") else 1.0
  day      <- seq(0, (length(ala) - 1) * dt_days, by = dt_days)
  expected <- ala0 * exp(-k_age_w_val * day)
  max_rerr <- max(abs(ala - expected) / (expected + 1e-12))

  check("2.4a", "ALU_ala decays exponentially (ageing)",
        max_rerr < tol_rel, sprintf("max relative error = %.4f", max_rerr))
  check("2.4b", "ALU_alp stays 0 during ageing", all(abs(alp) < tol_abs))

  df <- data.frame(day = day + 1, observed = ala, expected = expected,
                   ALU_alp = alp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed = "#1f77b4",
                                     expected = "black", ALU_alp = "#ff7f0e")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(observed = "solid",
                                       expected = "dashed", ALU_alp = "solid")) +
      labs(title = "2.4 Water-column ageing — exponential decay",
           subtitle = sprintf("ALU_ala vs. ala₀·exp(−k_age_w·t);  max rel err = %.4f",
                              max_rerr),
           x = "Day", y = "ALU_ala (mmol/m³)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("2.4", "Ageing decay test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

```{r}
S_ala_val   <- 200.0; k_age_w_val <- 0.0998
```

## 3. pH Modifier

### 3.1 `ALU_fpH` with pH_opt = simulated pH

Note that the simulated pH is quite high in this example (≈9.9 for Rotorua). The bell-curve modifier should be near 1.0 when `pH_opt` is set to match the simulated pH.

<details>

``` fortran
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .true.

/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-3-1
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 10.0, ads_use_pH = TRUE,
    pH_opt = 8.0, sigma_pH = 1.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  fpH <- surface(out, "ALU_fpH")
  # CAR_pH is dynamic (driven by carbon module); check mean fpH is close to 1
  # when pH_opt is set to match typical lake pH (~8.0 for Rotorua)
  ph_sim <- surface(out, "CHM_ph")  # simulated pH
  fpH_expected <- exp(-((ph_sim - 8.0)^2) / (2 * 1.0^2))
  fpH_err <- abs(fpH - fpH_expected)
  check("3.1", "ALU_fpH matches bell-curve given simulated pH",
        mean(fpH_err, na.rm = TRUE) < 0.05,
        sprintf("mean |fpH - expected| = %.4f", mean(fpH_err, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  p1 <- ggplot(data.frame(day = seq_along(ph_sim), ph_sim = ph_sim), aes(day, ph_sim)) +
    geom_line(colour = "steelblue") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 8.0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = "3.1 Simulated pH vs. pH_opt",
         subtitle = "pH_opt set to 8.0;",
         x = "Day", y = "Simulated pH") + th
  
  p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(day = seq_along(fpH), fpH = fpH, fpH_expected = fpH_expected),
                aes(day)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fpH), colour = pool_cols["ALU_fpH"]) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fpH_expected), linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
    labs(title = "3.1 ALU_fpH vs. expected from simulated pH",
         subtitle = "Dashed line is exp(-((pH_sim - pH_opt)^2)/(2*sigma^2))",
         x = "Day", y = "fpH (-)") + th
  print(p1 / p2)
  
} else {
  check("3.1", "fpH optimum test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 3.2 `ALU_fpH ≈ exp(−0.5)` at pH_opt ± σ

Run twice — pH_opt is shifted so that the simulated lake pH sits 1σ from optimum. `ALU_fpH` is checked against the bell-curve formula using the actual simulated pH.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 3.2</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 10.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .true.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 9.9 - sign_val * 1.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-3-2
#| echo: false

expected_fpH <- exp(-0.5)
results_32   <- list()

for (direction in c("below", "above")) {
  sign_val <- if (direction == "below") -1 else 1
  out <- safe_run(list(
    aed_alum = list(
      ala_initial = 10.0, ads_use_pH = TRUE,
      pH_opt   = 9.9 - sign_val * 1.0,
      sigma_pH = 1.0,
      k_w = 0.5, w_ala = 0.0, k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
    )
  ))
  id  <- paste0("3.2-", direction)
  lbl <- paste("ALU_fpH ≈ 0.6065 one sigma", direction)
  if (!is.null(out)) {
    fpH    <- surface(out, "ALU_fpH")
    ph_sim <- surface(out, "CHM_ph")
    ph_opt_used <- 6.0 - sign_val * 1.0
    fpH_formula <- exp(-((ph_sim - ph_opt_used)^2) / (2 * 1.0^2))
    err <- mean(abs(fpH - fpH_formula), na.rm = TRUE)
    check(id, lbl, err < 0.05,
          sprintf("mean |fpH - formula| = %.4f  (pH_sim mean=%.2f)", err, mean(ph_sim)))
    results_32[[direction]] <- data.frame(day = seq_along(fpH),
                                          fpH = fpH, direction = direction)
  } else {
    check(id, paste(lbl, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
  }
}

if (length(results_32) > 0) {
  df32 <- bind_rows(results_32)
  print(
    ggplot(df32, aes(day, fpH, colour = direction)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = expected_fpH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0,          linetype = "dotted",  colour = "grey60") +
      annotate("text", x = 2, y = expected_fpH + 0.02,
               label = sprintf("exp(-0.5) = %.4f", expected_fpH), size = 3) +
      ylim(0, 1.15) +
      labs(title = "3.2 ALU_fpH at ±1σ from pH_opt",
           subtitle = "Both lines should sit near exp(-0.5) ≈ 0.607",
           x = "Day", y = "fpH (-)") + th
  )
}

```

### 3.3 Uptake scales proportionally with `fpH`

Compare `ALU_uptake_w` at optimum vs. one sigma off. **Expect:** ratio ≈ `exp(−0.5)`.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 3.3</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 10.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .true.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 9.9
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-3-3
#| echo: false

out_opt <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 10.0, ads_use_pH = TRUE,
    pH_opt = 9.9, sigma_pH = 1.0,
    k_w = 0.5, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0, k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))
out_off <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 10.0, ads_use_pH = TRUE,
    pH_opt = 8.9, sigma_pH = 1.0,
    k_w = 0.5, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0, k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))

if (!is.null(out_opt) && !is.null(out_off)) {
  u_opt <- col_mean(out_opt, "ALU_uptake_w")
  ala_opt <- col_mean(out_opt, "ALU_ala")[1]
  frp_opt <- col_mean(out_opt, "PHS_frp")[1]
  
  u_off <- col_mean(out_off, "ALU_uptake_w")
  ala_off <- col_mean(out_off, "ALU_ala")[1]
  frp_off <- col_mean(out_off, "PHS_frp")[1]

  norm_opt <- u_opt[1] / (ala_opt * frp_opt / (0.3 + frp_opt) + 1e-12)  # ≈ k_w * fpH_opt
  norm_off <- u_off[1] / (ala_off * frp_off / (0.3 + frp_off) + 1e-12)  # ≈ k_w * fpH_off

  ratio <- norm_off / norm_opt   # should now match fpH_off/fpH_opt tightly
  
  fpH_opt <- col_mean(out_opt, "ALU_fpH")[1]
  fpH_off <- col_mean(out_off, "ALU_fpH")[1]
  # Expected ratio is fpH_off / fpH_opt (both evaluated at t=0)
  expected_ratio <- fpH_off / (fpH_opt + 1e-12)
  err   <- abs(ratio - expected_ratio) / (expected_ratio + 1e-12)

  check("3.3", "Uptake ratio matches fpH ratio at 1σ from pH_opt",
        err < 0.05,
        sprintf("expected ratio=%.4f (fpH_off/fpH_opt) observed=%.4f", expected_ratio, ratio))

  day <- seq_along(u_opt)
  df33 <- data.frame(day = day,
                     "pH = pH_opt" = u_opt,
                     "pH = pH_opt - 1σ" = u_off,
                     check.names = FALSE) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "scenario", values_to = "uptake_w")

  print(
    ggplot(df33, aes(day, uptake_w, colour = scenario)) +
      geom_line() +
      annotate("text", x = max(day) * 0.6, y = max(u_opt) * 0.6,
               label = sprintf("Ratio (t=0) = %.4f\nexp(-0.5) = %.4f",
                               ratio, exp(-0.5)), size = 3) +
      labs(title = "3.3 Uptake suppressed by pH offset",
           subtitle = "Off-optimum uptake should be ~60.7% of optimum",
           x = "Day", y = "ALU_uptake_w (mmol/m³/d)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("3.3", "Uptake scaling pH test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 3.5 Bell-curve shape across pH range

> **No model run** — theoretical plot of the bell-curve formula computed analytically from the default `pH_opt = 6.0` and `sigma_pH = 1.0` values.

Sweep `pH_opt` to simulate different pH values and confirm the bell-curve shape of `ALU_fpH`.

```{r}
#| label: test-3-5
#| echo: false

sigma_val  <- 1.0
ph_opt_ref <- 6.0
ph_sweep   <- seq(3, 10, by = 0.5)

fpH_theory <- exp(-((ph_sweep - ph_opt_ref)^2) / (2 * sigma_val^2))

print(
  ggplot(data.frame(pH = ph_sweep, fpH = fpH_theory), aes(pH, fpH)) +
    geom_line(colour = pool_cols["ALU_fpH"], linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ph_opt_ref, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = exp(-0.5),  linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
    annotate("text", x = ph_opt_ref + 0.2, y = 0.05,
             label = sprintf("pH_opt = %.1f", ph_opt_ref), size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.2, y = exp(-0.5) + 0.03,
             label = sprintf("exp(-0.5) = %.3f", exp(-0.5)), size = 3) +
    labs(title = "3.5 Theoretical bell-curve shape of fpH modifier",
         subtitle = sprintf("sigma_pH = %.1f; shows expected alum efficiency vs pH",
                            sigma_val),
         x = "pH", y = "fpH (-)") + th
)
```

```{r}
out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 10.0, alp_initial = 5.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.0, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )

  ala_bot  <- bottom(out, "ALU_ala")  # bottom layer loses to deposition
  alp_bot  <- bottom(out, "ALU_alp")
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")  # column sum for plot
  alp      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")

  check("4.1a", "ALU_ala (bottom) declines with settling",  all(diff(ala_bot) <= tol_abs))
  check("4.1b", "ALU_alp (bottom) declines with settling",  all(diff(alp_bot) <= tol_abs))
  check("4.1c", "ALU_ben_ala increases with settling", all(diff(ben_ala) >= -tol_abs))
  check("4.1d", "ALU_ben_alp increases with settling", all(diff(ben_alp) >= -tol_abs))
  check("4.1e", "ALU_uptake_w = 0 (settling only)",   all(abs(uptake_w)  < tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(ala)
  df <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_ala = ala, ALU_alp = alp,
                   ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala, ALU_ben_alp = ben_alp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
      labs(title = "4.1 Settling only — pelagic decline, benthic rise",
           subtitle = "Pelagic pools decline; benthic pools accumulate",
           x = "Day", y = "Concentration") + th
  )
} else {
  for (id in paste0("4.1", letters[1:5]))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

<details>

```{r}
#| label: test-4-5
#| echo: false

k_age_s_val <- 0.0998
ben_ala0 <- 10.0

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = ben_ala0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.0, k_s = 0.0, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = k_age_s_val, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  ben_ala  <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_ala_Z")
  ben_alp  <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ben_alp_Z")
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  # Infer output timestep from GLM output metadata (days)
  dt_days  <- if (!is.null(attr(out, "dt_days"))) attr(out, "dt_days") else 1.0
  day      <- seq(0, (length(ben_ala) - 1) * dt_days, by = dt_days)
  expected <- ben_ala0 * exp(-k_age_s_val * day)
  max_rerr <- max(abs(ben_ala - expected) / (expected + 1e-12))

  check("4.5a", "ALU_ben_ala decays exponentially (benthic ageing)",
        max_rerr < tol_rel, sprintf("max rel error = %.4f", max_rerr))
  check("4.5b", "ALU_ben_alp unchanged during benthic ageing", all(abs(ben_alp) < tol_abs))
  check("4.5c", "ALU_ala column-sum ≈ 0 during benthic ageing", max(abs(ala)) < 0.01)

  df <- data.frame(day = day + 1, observed = ben_ala, expected = expected) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed = pool_cols["ALU_ben_ala"],
                                     expected = "black")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(observed = "solid", expected = "dashed")) +
      labs(title = "4.5 Benthic ageing — exponential decay",
           subtitle = sprintf("Observed vs. ben_ala₀·exp(−k_age_s·t); max rel err = %.4f",
                              max_rerr),
           x = "Day", y = "ALU_ben_ala (mmol/m²)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("4.5", "Benthic ageing test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

## 5. Mass Balance Tests

### 5.1 Full phosphorus mass balance — no dosing, no burial

`Δ(PHS_frp) + Δ(ALU_alp) + Δ(ALU_ben_alp) ≈ 0` at every timestep.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 5.1</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 20.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 5.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-5-1
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 20.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0,
    simResuspension = FALSE, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  frp_mass <- wc_mass(out, "PHS_frp")
  alp_mass <- wc_mass(out, "ALU_alp")
  ben_mass <- benthic_mass(out, "ALU_ben_alp_Z")
  total_p  <- frp_mass + alp_mass + ben_mass
  residual <- diff(total_p)
  max_resid <- max(abs(residual))

  # Sediment flux adds FRP independently — tolerance 5% of mean total-P flux (mmol)
  mean_flux <- mean(abs(diff(total_p)), na.rm = TRUE)
  tol_mb5   <- max(tol_abs, 0.05 * mean_flux)
  check("5.1", "Δ(FRP_mass+ALU_alp_mass+ALU_ben_alp_mass) ≈ 0 (total P conserved, mmol)",
        max_resid < tol_mb5, sprintf("max residual = %.2e mmol  tol = %.2e", max_resid, tol_mb5))

  day <- seq_along(frp_mass)
  df_conc <- data.frame(day = day,
                        FRP_mass = frp_mass, ALU_alp_mass = alp_mass,
                        ALU_ben_alp_mass = ben_mass, Total_P_mass = total_p) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  df_resid <- data.frame(day = day[-1], residual = residual)
  
  sel_cols <- c(pool_cols["PHS_frp"], pool_cols["ALU_alp"],
                pool_cols["ALU_ben_alp"], "black")
  names(sel_cols) <- c("FRP_mass", "ALU_alp_mass", "ALU_ben_alp_mass", "Total_P_mass")

  p1 <- ggplot(df_conc, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = sel_cols) +
    labs(title = "5.1 Total P mass balance (mmol)",
         subtitle = "Total_P_mass (black) should be flat",
         x = "Day", y = "Mass (mmol)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_resid, aes(day, residual)) +
    geom_line(colour = "firebrick") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "5.1 Residual Δ(total P) per timestep",
         subtitle = sprintf("Max = %.2e  (should be ~machine precision)", max_resid),
         x = "Day", y = "Residual") + th

  # ── Cross-check against GLM's own internal mass-balance accounting ─────────
  # Independent of the netcdf-reconstructed masses above: glm_balance.c tracks
  # inflow/outflow/lake totals itself. mass_balance only covers water-column
  # vars (no benthic pools), so compare against the pelagic portion only
  # (FRP + ALU_alp; ALU_ala is alum binding *capacity*, not phosphorus mass,
  # and is excluded from total_p above for the same reason).
  mb <- out[["mass_balance"]]
  if (!is.null(mb) && nrow(mb) == length(day)) {
    wc_recon   <- frp_mass + alp_mass
    wc_native  <- mb$lake_PHS_frp + mb$lake_ALU_alp
    mb_resid   <- max(abs(wc_recon - wc_native), na.rm = TRUE)
    mb_tol     <- max(tol_abs, 0.05 * mean(abs(wc_recon), na.rm = TRUE))

    check("5.1-mb", "Reconstructed water-column P mass matches GLM's own mass_balance accounting",
          mb_resid < mb_tol,
          sprintf("max |reconstructed - native| = %.2e mmol  tol = %.2e", mb_resid, mb_tol))

    df_cross <- data.frame(day = day,
                           reconstructed_netcdf    = wc_recon,
                           glm_native_mass_balance = wc_native) |>
      pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "source", values_to = "value")

    p3 <- ggplot(df_cross, aes(day, value, colour = source, linetype = source)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(reconstructed_netcdf    = pool_cols["PHS_frp"],
                                     glm_native_mass_balance = "black")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(reconstructed_netcdf    = "solid",
                                       glm_native_mass_balance = "dashed")) +
      labs(title = "5.1 Water-column P — netcdf reconstruction vs. GLM's own mass_balance",
           subtitle = "Two independently-computed sources; should overlap if mass is truly conserved",
           x = "Day", y = "Mass (mmol)") + th

    print(p1 / p2 / p3)
  } else {
    if (!is.null(mb)) {
      message(sprintf("5.1: mass_balance rows (%d) != netcdf timesteps (%d); skipping cross-check plot",
                      nrow(mb), length(day)))
    }
    print(p1 / p2)
  }
} else {
  check("5.1", "Full P mass balance (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 5.2 Cumulative uptake matches `ALU_alp` accumulation

Water-column only (no settling). `Σ ALU_uptake_w ≈ ALU_alp` at end.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 5.2</summary>

``` fortran

   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-5-2
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 50.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.0, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_age_s = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  # Use mass (mmol) for both sides so units match
  uptake_mass <- wc_mass(out, "ALU_uptake_w")   # mmol/d at each timestep
  alp_mass    <- wc_mass(out, "ALU_alp")        # mmol (stock)
  cum_uptake  <- cumsum(uptake_mass)             # cumulative mmol removed
  final_alp   <- tail(alp_mass, 1)
  final_upk   <- tail(cum_uptake, 1)
  rel_err     <- abs(final_alp - final_upk) / (final_alp + 1e-12)

  check("5.2", "Σ ALU_uptake_w_mass ≈ ALU_alp_mass (cumulative integral, 1% tolerance)",
        rel_err < 0.01,
        sprintf("alp_mass=%.2f mmol  Σuptake_mass=%.2f mmol  rel_err=%.4f",
                final_alp, final_upk, rel_err))

  day <- seq_along(alp_mass)
  df <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_alp_mass = alp_mass,
                   cumulative_uptake_mass = cum_uptake) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")
  
  sel_cols <- c(pool_cols["ALU_alp"], "black")
  names(sel_cols) <- c("ALU_alp_mass", "cumulative_uptake_mass")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = sel_cols) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(ALU_alp_mass = "solid",
                                       cumulative_uptake_mass = "dashed")) +
      labs(title = "5.2 Cumulative uptake mass vs. ALU_alp mass (mmol)",
           subtitle = sprintf("Should overlap; rel error = %.4f", rel_err),
           x = "Day", y = "Mass (mmol)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("5.2", "Uptake integral test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

```{r}
#| label: test-5-3
#| echo: false

glm_53 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FRP, flow = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FLOW)
out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = TRUE, k_res = 0.05, S_ala = 200.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_53)

if (!is.null(out)) {
  ala     <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  ben_ala <- get_var(out, "ALU_ben_ala")
  frp     <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  n       <- length(ala)
  ss_idx  <- tail(seq_len(n), max(10L, round(n * 0.1)))
  ala_cv  <- sd(ala[ss_idx])     / (mean(ala[ss_idx])     + 1e-12)
  ben_cv  <- sd(ben_ala[ss_idx]) / (mean(ben_ala[ss_idx]) + 1e-12)

  check("5.3a", "ALU_ala at steady state (CV < 5%)",
        ala_cv < 0.05, sprintf("CV = %.4f", ala_cv))
  check("5.3b", "ALU_ben_ala at steady state (CV < 5%)",
        ben_cv < 0.05, sprintf("CV = %.4f", ben_cv))

  day <- seq_along(ala)
  df <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_ala = ala,
                   ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala, PHS_frp = frp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = day[min(ss_idx)],
                 linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
      annotate("text", x = day[min(ss_idx)] + 1,
               y = max(ala, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
               label = "SS window →", hjust = 0, size = 3) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
      labs(title = "5.3 Steady state — all processes active",
           subtitle = sprintf("ALU_ala CV=%.3f  ALU_ben_ala CV=%.3f (target <0.05)",
                              ala_cv, ben_cv),
           x = "Day", y = "Concentration") + th
  )
} else {
  check("5.3", "Steady state test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: test-6-1
#| echo: false

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 10.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.0, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  frp      <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  alp      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")

  check("6.1a", "No NaN in ALU_uptake_w (high FRP)",   all(is.finite(uptake_w)))
  check("6.1b", "No NaN in ALU_alp (high FRP)",        all(is.finite(alp)))
  check("6.1c", "PHS_frp >= 0 (high FRP)",             all(frp >= -tol_abs))
  check("6.1d", "ALU_uptake_w <= k_w × ala (saturation cap)",
        all(uptake_w <= 0.5 * 10.0 + tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(uptake_w)
  saturation_limit <- 0.5 * ala   # k_w * ala at each timestep
  df <- data.frame(day = day, observed_uptake_w = uptake_w,
                   saturation_ceiling = saturation_limit) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed_uptake_w = pool_cols["ALU_uptake_w"],

      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(observed_uptake_w = "solid",
                                       saturation_ceiling = "dashed")) +
      labs(title = "6.1 High FRP — uptake vs. saturation ceiling",
           subtitle = "Observed uptake must stay below k_w × ALU_ala",
           x = "Day", y = "ALU_uptake_w (mmol/m³/d)") + th
  )
} else {
  for (id in paste0("6.1", letters[1:4]))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

```{r}

  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 1.0, alp_initial = 0.0,

  check("6.2c", "PHS_frp >= 0 (exhaustion)",     all(frp     >= -tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(ala)

                   ALU_ala = ala, ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala,
                   ALU_uptake_w = uptake_w,
                   ALU_uptake_s = as.numeric(uptake_s)) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(

      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +

  )
} else {

    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: test-7-1
#| echo: false

glm_71 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FRP, flow = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FLOW)
# No-dosing baseline for comparison
out_71_nd <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_71)
out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 500.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_71)

if (!is.null(out)) {
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  alp      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_alp")
  ben_ala  <- get_var(out, "ALU_ben_ala")
  ben_alp  <- get_var(out, "ALU_ben_alp")
  frp      <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  frp_nd   <- if (!is.null(out_71_nd)) col_mean(out_71_nd, "PHS_frp") else frp * NA

  check("7.1a", "ALU_ala declines after pulse",    ala[length(ala)]  < ala[1])
  check("7.1b", "PHS_frp lower than no-dosing baseline (pulse effect)",
        mean(tail(frp, 10)) < mean(tail(frp_nd, 10)))
  check("7.1c", "ALU_ben_alp > 0 after settling",  max(ben_alp)      > 0)
  check("7.1d", "ALU_ala >= 0 throughout",          all(ala     >= -tol_abs))
  check("7.1e", "ALU_ben_ala >= 0 throughout",      all(ben_ala >= -tol_abs))
  check("7.1f", "PHS_frp >= 0 throughout",          all(frp     >= -tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(ala)
  df_pools <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_ala = ala, ALU_alp = alp,
                         ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala, ALU_ben_alp = ben_alp,
                         PHS_frp = frp) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  df_upk <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_uptake_w = uptake_w)

  p1 <- ggplot(df_pools, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
    labs(title = "7.1 Pulse lifecycle — pool trajectories",
         subtitle = "ALU_ala → settles → ben_ala → ben_alp → buried",
         x = "Day", y = "Concentration") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_upk, aes(day, ALU_uptake_w)) +
    geom_line(colour = pool_cols["ALU_uptake_w"]) +
    labs(title = "7.1 Water-column uptake rate over time",
         subtitle = "Should peak early then decline as ALU_ala is exhausted",
         x = "Day", y = "ALU_uptake_w (mmol/m³/d)") + th

  print(p1 / p2)
} else {
  for (id in paste0("7.1", letters[1:6]))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

```{r}
#| label: test-7-2
#| echo: false

glm_72 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FRP, flow = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FLOW)
out_72_nd <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 50.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_72, init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))
out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 50.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE, S_ala = 200.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_72, init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  frp      <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  uptake_s <- as.numeric(get_var(out, "ALU_uptake_s"))
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  ben_ala  <- get_var(out, "ALU_ben_ala")
  frp_nd   <- if (!is.null(out_72_nd)) col_mean(out_72_nd, "PHS_frp") else frp * NA

  check("7.2a", "PHS_frp lower than no-dosing baseline (dosing effect)",
        mean(tail(frp, 10)) < mean(tail(frp_nd, 10)))
  check("7.2b", "PHS_frp >= 0 throughout",          all(frp >= -tol_abs))

  total_w <- sum(uptake_w, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_s <- sum(uptake_s, na.rm = TRUE)

  day <- seq_along(frp)
  df_frp <- data.frame(day = day, PHS_frp = frp)
  df_upk <- data.frame(day = day,
                       water_column = uptake_w,
                       benthic      = uptake_s) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "uptake")
  df_cap <- data.frame(day = day, ALU_ala = ala, ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  p1 <- ggplot(df_frp, aes(day, PHS_frp)) +
    geom_line(colour = pool_cols["PHS_frp"]) +
    labs(title = "7.2 FRP recovery trajectory",
         subtitle = "Should decline monotonically",
         x = "Day", y = "PHS_frp (mmol/m³)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_upk, aes(day, uptake, colour = compartment)) +
    geom_line() +
    annotate("text", x = max(day) * 0.5, y = max(uptake_w) * 0.8,
             label = sprintf("Total water : benthic = %.1f : %.1f\nratio = %.2f",
                             total_w, total_s, total_w / (total_s + 1e-12)),
             size = 3, hjust = 0) +
    labs(title = "7.2 Uptake by compartment",
         subtitle = "Relative contribution of water-column vs. benthic removal",
         x = "Day", y = "Uptake (mmol/m³ or /m² per d)") + th

  p3 <- ggplot(df_cap, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
    labs(title = "7.2 Capacity pools over time",
         x = "Day", y = "Concentration") + th

  print(p1 / p2 / p3)
} else {
  for (id in c("7.2a","7.2b"))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}
```

## 8. Diagnostic Output Tests

### 8.1 `ALU_uptake_w` scaling at saturation

At FRP \>\> K_P, `ALU_uptake_w` should approach `k_w × ALU_ala`.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 8.1</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum
   ala_initial          = 10.0
   alp_initial          = 0.0
   ben_ala_initial      = 0.0
   ben_alp_initial      = 0.0
   frp_variable         = 'PHS_frp'
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.0
   K_P                  = 0.3
   w_ala                = 0.0
   k_age_w              = 0.0
   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.0
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.
   pH_variable          = 'CAR_pH'
   pH_opt               = 6.0
   sigma_pH             = 1.0
   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-8-1
#| echo: false

k_w_val <- 0.5; ala0 <- 10.0

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = ala0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = k_w_val, k_s = 0.0, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 0.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), init_wq = list(PHS_frp = INIT_FRP_HIGH))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  frp      <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  expected <- k_w_val * ala0
  rel_err  <- abs(uptake_w[1] - expected) / expected
  ceiling  <- k_w_val * ala   # theoretical max at each timestep

  check("8.1", "ALU_uptake_w ≤ k_w × ala at saturation (≤5% margin)",
        rel_err < 0.05,
        sprintf("expected≤%.2f  observed=%.4f  rel_err=%.4f",
                expected, uptake_w[1], rel_err))

  day <- seq_along(uptake_w)
  df <- data.frame(day = day, observed = uptake_w,
                   saturation_ceiling = ceiling) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed = pool_cols["ALU_uptake_w"],
                                     saturation_ceiling = "black")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(observed = "solid",
                                       saturation_ceiling = "dashed")) +
      annotate("text", x = 2, y = expected * 0.95,
               label = sprintf("t=0: observed=%.3f\nceiling=%.3f",
                               uptake_w[1], expected),
               size = 3, hjust = 0) +
      labs(title = "8.1 uptake_w vs. saturation ceiling (k_w × ALU_ala)",
           subtitle = "Observed must lie at or below the dashed ceiling",
           x = "Day", y = "ALU_uptake_w (mmol/m³/d)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("8.1", "Uptake_w scaling test (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 8.3 `ALU_fpH` diagnostic matches bell-curve formula

At pH_opt shifted by 1σ, `ALU_fpH` must equal `exp(−0.5) ≈ 0.6065`.

``` fortran
   k_s                  = 0.1

   k_age_s              = 0.0998

   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .true.
```

```{r}
#| label: test-8-3
#| echo: false

pH_opt_val <- 7.0; sigma_val <- 1.5

out <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 10.0, ads_use_pH = TRUE,
    pH_opt   = pH_opt_val - sigma_val,
    sigma_pH = sigma_val,
    k_w = 0.5, w_ala = 0.0, k_age_w = 0.0, k_bur = 0.0, S_ala = 0.0
  )
))

if (!is.null(out)) {
  fpH      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_fpH")
  expected <- exp(-0.5)
  rel_err  <- abs(fpH[1] - expected) / expected

  check("8.3", "ALU_fpH matches bell-curve formula at 1σ",
        rel_err < tol_rel,
        sprintf("expected=%.4f  observed=%.4f  rel_err=%.4f",
                expected, fpH[1], rel_err))

  day <- seq_along(fpH)
  print(
    ggplot(data.frame(day = day, ALU_fpH = fpH), aes(day, ALU_fpH)) +
      geom_line(colour = pool_cols["ALU_fpH"]) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = expected, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0,      linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
      annotate("text", x = max(day) * 0.5, y = expected + 0.03,
               label = sprintf("exp(-0.5) = %.4f", expected), size = 3) +
      ylim(0, 1.15) +
      labs(title = "8.3 ALU_fpH diagnostic vs. bell-curve formula",
           subtitle = sprintf("pH_opt shifted by 1σ; expected fpH = %.4f, observed = %.4f",
                              expected, fpH[1]),
           x = "Day", y = "fpH (-)") + th
  )
} else {
  check("8.3", "fpH diagnostic formula (run failed)", FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

## 9. Inflow Tests

Section 9 introduces a continuous FRP inflow to the lake, which is more realistic than a closed system and directly mirrors the Rotorua setup where streams (Utuhina, Puarenga) supply FRP continuously. Three scenarios are tested: a no-dosing baseline to confirm the inflow load is represented correctly, S_ala surface dosing to quantify removal efficiency against the inflowing load, and alum dosed via the inflow concentration rather than `S_ala` to check whether the spatial entry point matters.

All three tests share the same inflow file and GLM configuration. Substitute the placeholder values below with your actual inflow data before running.

```{r}
#| label: inflow-setup
#| echo: false

# ── PLACEHOLDERS — substitute with your actual values ────────────────────────

# Path to your GLM inflow file (CSV with Date column + variable columns).
# The file must already contain a PHS_frp column.  For test 9.3 it must
# also contain an ALU_ala column.
INFLOW_FILE <- "LakeRotorua/bcs/inflow_Utuhina.csv"
inflow <- read.csv(INFLOW_FILE)
inflow$flow <- mean(inflow$flow, na.rm = TRUE)  # placeholder if flow column missing
INFLOW_FRP_CONC <- 0.5
INFLOW_ALA_CONC <- 1.2

inflow_ex_file <- "LakeRotorua/bcs/inflow_example.csv"
write.csv(inflow, inflow_ex_file, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

glm_file <- "LakeRotorua/glm4.nml"
glm <- read_nml(glm_file)
glm$inflow$num_inflows <- 1
glm$inflow$names_of_strms <- "Utuhina"
glm$inflow$inflow_fl <- "bcs/inflow_example.csv"

write_nml(glm, "LakeRotorua/glm4.nml")

hyps <- AEME::read_model_hypsograph(model = "glm_aed", file = glm_file)
hyps <- hyps |> 
  dplyr::filter(depth <= 0)

INFLOW_FLOW_M3D <- mean(inflow$flow, na.rm = TRUE) * 86400

# ALU_ala concentration to write into the inflow for test 9.3 (mmol P/m³).
# Derived from field alum dose rate and stream flow:
#   dose_mg_Al_L × (1 mmol Al / 26.98 mg) × binding_stoichiometry / 1000
INFLOW_ALA_CONC <- 1.2            # PLACEHOLDER — mmol P/m³

# Lake surface area (m²) — used to convert areal benthic fluxes to totals.
LAKE_AREA_M2 <- max(hyps$area)               # PLACEHOLDER — e.g. Lake Rotorua ~80 km²

# Lake volume (m³) — used to convert volumetric concentrations to totals.
LAKE_VOL_M3  <- calc_lake_vol(hyps = hyps)               # PLACEHOLDER

# ── Helper: write an inflow CSV with specified PHS_frp and ALU_ala columns ───
# `frp_conc`  constant FRP concentration (mmol P/m³)
# `ala_conc`  ALU_ala concentration (mmol P/m³); NA omits the column
write_inflow <- function(frp_conc, ala_conc = NA) {
  base <- read.csv(INFLOW_FILE)   # read existing inflow (must have Date + flow cols)
  base[["PHS_frp"]] <- frp_conc
  if (!is.na(ala_conc)) base[["ALU_ala"]] <- ala_conc
  write.csv(base, inflow_ex_file, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  inflow_ex_file
}

# ── Helper: compute total FRP load delivered by the inflow (mmol P) ──────────
# Assumes constant flow and concentration for simplicity; extend as needed.
frp_load_total <- function(flow_m3s, frp_conc, n_days) {
  flow_m3s * 86400 * frp_conc * n_days
}

cat("Inflow setup complete — check PLACEHOLDER values before running.\n")

```

### 9.1 Constant FRP inflow — no dosing baseline

FRP enters via the inflow at a constant concentration; no alum applied. **Expect:** lake FRP rises toward a new equilibrium set by inflow load vs. outflow; `ALU_uptake_w` and `ALU_uptake_s` remain 0; all alum pools stay 0.

``` fortran
   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1

   k_age_s              = 0.0998

   S_ala                = 0.0
   diag_level           = 10
/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-9-1
#| echo: false

# No-dosing baseline — use scenario inflow; stored as out_91 for reuse in 9.4
glm_91 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FRP,
                           flow = INFLOW_SCENARIO_FLOW)

out_91 <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial     = 0.0,
    alp_initial     = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0,
    ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w             = 0.5,
    k_s             = 0.1,
    K_P             = 0.3,
    w_ala           = 5.0,
    k_age_w         = 0.0998,
    k_age_s         = 0.0998,
    k_bur           = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE,
    S_ala           = 0.0
  )
), glm_nml = glm_91)
out <- out_91   # alias for check/plot infrastructure below

if (!is.null(out)) {
  frp      <- col_mean(out, "PHS_frp")
  ala      <- col_mean(out, "ALU_ala")
  uptake_w <- col_mean(out, "ALU_uptake_w")
  uptake_s <- as.numeric(get_var(out, "ALU_uptake_s"))

  check("9.1a", "ALU_ala = 0 (no dosing, inflow baseline)",
        all(abs(ala) < tol_abs))
  check("9.1b", "ALU_uptake_w = 0 (no dosing, inflow baseline)",
        all(abs(uptake_w) < tol_abs))
  check("9.1c", "ALU_uptake_s = 0 (no dosing, inflow baseline)",
        all(abs(uptake_s) < tol_abs))
  check("9.1d", "PHS_frp rises with FRP inflow (no dosing)",
        frp[length(frp)] > frp[1])

  day <- seq_along(frp)
  df  <- data.frame(day = day, PHS_frp = frp,
                    ALU_uptake_w = uptake_w,
                    ALU_uptake_s = uptake_s) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
      labs(title = "9.1 Inflow baseline — no alum dosing",
           subtitle = paste0("FRP should rise; uptake_w and uptake_s must be 0\n",
                             sprintf("Inflow FRP = %.3f mmol/m³  |  Flow = %.0f m³/d",
                                     INFLOW_SCENARIO_FRP, INFLOW_SCENARIO_FLOW)),
           x = "Day", y = "Value") + th
  )
} else {
  for (id in paste0("9.1", letters[1:4]))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 9.2 Constant FRP inflow + surface dosing (`S_ala`)

Same inflow as 9.1; alum applied via `S_ala` at the lake surface. **Expect:** lake FRP reaches a lower steady state than 9.1; cumulative `ALU_uptake_w + ALU_uptake_s` accounts for the FRP reduction relative to the no-dosing baseline; removal efficiency is quantified as a fraction of inflowing load.

<details>

<summary>📋 `&aed_alum` namelist for test 9.2</summary>

``` fortran
&aed_alum

   k_w                  = 0.5
   k_s                  = 0.1
   K_P                  = 0.3

   k_age_s              = 0.0998
   k_bur                = 0.01
   simResuspension      = .false.
   k_res                = 0.0
   ads_use_pH           = .false.

/
```

</details>

```{r}
#| label: test-9-2
#| echo: false
#| dependson: "inflow-setup"

inflow_92 <- write_inflow_glm(glm_nml = glm_def, frp_conc = INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP,
                              flow = INFLOW_KINETIC_FLOW,
                              ala_conc = 0)

out_nodose <- safe_run(list(          # re-use 9.1 result if already in env
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE, S_ala = 0.0
  )
), glm_nml = inflow_92)

out_dose <- safe_run(list(
  aed_alum = list(
    ala_initial = 0.0, alp_initial = 0.0,
    ben_ala_initial = 0.0, ben_alp_initial = 0.0,
    k_w = 0.5, k_s = 0.1, K_P = 0.3, w_ala = 5.0,
    k_age_w = 0.0998, k_age_s = 0.0998, k_bur = 0.01,
    simResuspension = FALSE,
    S_ala = 200.0                       # PLACEHOLDER — replace with target dose
  )
), glm_nml = inflow_92)

if (!is.null(out_nodose) && !is.null(out_dose)) {
  frp_nd   <- wc_mass(out_nodose, "PHS_frp")
  frp_d    <- wc_mass(out_dose, "PHS_frp")
  uptake_w <- wc_mass(out_dose, "ALU_uptake_w")
  uptake_s <- get_var(out_dose, "ALU_uptake_s")

  # wc_mass / benthic_mass handle volume/area weighting automatically
  uptake_w_mass <- wc_mass(out_dose, "ALU_uptake_w")        # mmol/d per timestep
  uptake_s_mass <- benthic_mass(out_dose, "ALU_uptake_s_Z") # mmol/d per timestep
  removed_total <- sum(uptake_w_mass + uptake_s_mass, na.rm = TRUE)  # total mmol P
  load_total    <- frp_load_total(flow_m3s = INFLOW_KINETIC_FLOW,
                                  frp_conc = INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP, 
                                  n_days = length(frp_d))             # total mmol P delivered
  efficiency    <- removed_total / (load_total + 1e-12)

  check("9.2a", "PHS_frp lower with dosing than without",
        mean(tail(frp_d, 10)) < mean(tail(frp_nd, 10)))
  check("9.2b", "PHS_frp >= 0 with inflow + dosing",
        all(frp_d >= -tol_abs))
  check("9.2c", "Removal efficiency between 0 and 1",
        efficiency >= 0 & efficiency <= 1,
        sprintf("efficiency = %.3f", efficiency))

  day <- seq_along(frp_d)
  df_frp <- data.frame(day = day,
                       no_dosing = frp_nd,
                       S_ala_dosing = frp_d) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "scenario", values_to = "PHS_frp")

  df_upk <- data.frame(day = day,
                       water_column_mass = uptake_w_mass,
                       benthic_mass      = uptake_s_mass) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "uptake_mmol_d")

  p1 <- ggplot(df_frp, aes(day, PHS_frp, colour = scenario)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "9.2 FRP trajectory: no dosing vs. S_ala dosing",
         subtitle = sprintf("Removal efficiency = %.1f%% of inflowing FRP load",
                            efficiency * 100),
         x = "Day", y = "PHS_frp (mmol/m³)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_upk, aes(day, uptake_mmol_d, colour = compartment)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "9.2 Uptake by compartment — mass basis (mmol/d)",
         subtitle = "Relative contribution of water-column vs. benthic removal",
         x = "Day", y = "Uptake (mmol P/d)") + th

  print(p1 / p2)

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n9.2 Summary:\n  Inflow FRP load (total) : %.2e mmol P\n  Total removed by alum   : %.2e mmol P\n  Removal efficiency      : %.1f%%\n",
    load_total, removed_total, efficiency * 100
  ))
} else {
  for (id in c("9.2a","9.2b","9.2c"))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

```{r}
if (!is.null(out_inflow_dosed)) {
```
