```{r}
                                     frp_conc = INFLOW_KINETIC_FRP, 
                                     n_days = length(frp))
  efficiency_93    <- removed_total / (load_total + 1e-12)

  check("9.3a", "ALU_ala > 0 (alum enters via inflow)",
        any(ala > tol_abs))
  check("9.3b", "PHS_frp >= 0 (inflow-dosed scenario)",
        all(frp >= -tol_abs))
  check("9.3c", "ALU_uptake_w > 0 (binding occurs)",
        any(uptake_w > tol_abs))
  check("9.3d", "Removal efficiency between 0 and 1",
        efficiency_93 >= 0 & efficiency_93 <= 1,
        sprintf("efficiency = %.3f", efficiency_93))

  day <- seq_along(frp)
  df_pools <- data.frame(day = day,
                         PHS_frp = frp, ALU_ala = ala,
                         ALU_ben_ala = ben_ala) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  df_upk <- data.frame(day = day,
                       water_column_mass = uptake_w_mass_93,
                       benthic_mass      = uptake_s_mass_93) |>
    pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "uptake_mmol_d")

  p1 <- ggplot(df_pools, aes(day, value, colour = variable)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pool_cols) +
    labs(title = "9.3 Inflow-dosed alum — pool trajectories",
         subtitle = sprintf("ALU_ala_inflow = %.3f mmol/m³  |  Removal = %.1f%%",
                            INFLOW_ALA_CONC, efficiency_93 * 100),
         x = "Day", y = "Concentration (mmol/m³)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_upk, aes(day, uptake_mmol_d, colour = compartment)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "9.3 Uptake by compartment — mass basis (mmol/d)",
         x = "Day", y = "Uptake (mmol P/d)") + th

  print(p1 / p2)

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n9.3 Summary:\n  Inflow ALU_ala conc     : %.3f mmol/m³\n  Total removed by alum   : %.2e mmol P\n  Removal efficiency      : %.1f%%\n",
    INFLOW_ALA_CONC, removed_total, efficiency_93 * 100
  ))
} else {
  for (id in paste0("9.3", letters[1:4]))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed)"), FALSE, "run_test returned NULL")
}

```

### 9.4 Entry-point comparison — inflow dosing vs. `S_ala`

> **No separate namelist** — this test reuses `out_dose` from test 9.2 and `out_inflow_dosed` from test 9.3. Run those two tests first.

Directly compare removal efficiency between test 9.2 (`S_ala` surface dosing) and test 9.3 (inflow-concentration dosing) at equivalent total alum loads. **Expect:** both approaches remove FRP; any efficiency difference reflects the importance of where in the water column alum is introduced.

```{r}
#| label: test-9-4
#| echo: false
#| dependson: ["test-9-1", "test-9-2", "test-9-3"]

# This test requires both out_dose (from 9.2) and out_inflow_dosed (from 9.3)
# to be present in the environment.
if (!is.null(out_dose) && !is.null(out_inflow_dosed)) {

  frp_s_ala   <- col_mean(out_dose, "PHS_frp")
  frp_inflow  <- col_mean(out_inflow_dosed, "PHS_frp")
  ala_s_ala   <- col_mean(out_dose, "ALU_ala")
  ala_inflow  <- col_mean(out_inflow_dosed, "ALU_ala")

  frp_end_s_ala  <- mean(tail(frp_s_ala,  10))
  frp_end_inflow <- mean(tail(frp_inflow, 10))

  frp_baseline   <- if (!is.null(out_91)) col_mean(out_91, "PHS_frp") else frp_s_ala * NA
  frp_end_nd     <- mean(tail(frp_baseline, 10), na.rm = TRUE)
  check("9.4a", "Both scenarios achieve FRP below no-dosing baseline (9.1)",
        frp_end_s_ala  < frp_end_nd &&
        frp_end_inflow < frp_end_nd,
        sprintf("no-dosing=%.4f  S_ala=%.4f  inflow=%.4f",
                frp_end_nd, frp_end_s_ala, frp_end_inflow))
  check("9.4b", "FRP >= 0 in both scenarios",
        all(frp_s_ala >= -tol_abs) && all(frp_inflow >= -tol_abs))

  day <- seq_along(frp_s_ala)
  df_comp <- data.frame(
    day              = day,
    "S_ala (surface)"  = frp_s_ala,
    "ALU_ala (inflow)" = frp_inflow,
    "No dosing"        = frp_nd,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) |> pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "scenario", values_to = "PHS_frp")

  df_ala <- data.frame(
    day              = day,
    "S_ala (surface)"  = ala_s_ala,
    "ALU_ala (inflow)" = ala_inflow,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) |> pivot_longer(-day, names_to = "scenario", values_to = "ALU_ala")

  p1 <- ggplot(df_comp, aes(day, PHS_frp, colour = scenario)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "9.4 FRP comparison: S_ala vs. inflow dosing vs. no dosing",
         subtitle = sprintf(
           "S_ala endpoint: %.4f | Inflow endpoint: %.4f | No dosing: %.4f mmol/m³",
           frp_end_s_ala, frp_end_inflow, mean(tail(frp_nd, 10))),
         x = "Day", y = "PHS_frp (mmol/m³)") + th

  p2 <- ggplot(df_ala, aes(day, ALU_ala, colour = scenario)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "9.4 ALU_ala in water column: S_ala vs. inflow dosing",
         subtitle = "Distribution of suspended capacity differs by entry point",
         x = "Day", y = "ALU_ala (mmol/m³)") + th

  print(p1 / p2)

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n9.4 Entry-point comparison:\n  Final FRP — S_ala dosing  : %.4f mmol/m³\n  Final FRP — inflow dosing : %.4f mmol/m³\n  Difference               : %.4f mmol/m³ (%.1f%%)\n",
    frp_end_s_ala, frp_end_inflow,
    abs(frp_end_s_ala - frp_end_inflow),
    abs(frp_end_s_ala - frp_end_inflow) / (frp_end_s_ala + 1e-12) * 100
  ))
} else {
  for (id in c("9.4a","9.4b"))
    check(id, paste(id, "(run failed — requires 9.2 and 9.3 outputs)"),
          FALSE, "out_dose or out_inflow_dosed is NULL")
}

```

## Summary {#summary}

```{r}
#| label: summary
#| echo: false

results <- .test_results

n_pass  <- sum(results$status == "PASS")
n_fail  <- sum(results$status == "FAIL")
n_error <- sum(results$status == "ERROR")
n_total <- nrow(results)

cat(sprintf("\n%d tests run:  %d PASS  |  %d FAIL  |  %d ERROR\n\n",
            n_total, n_pass, n_fail, n_error))

results$Result <- ifelse(results$status == "PASS", "\u2705 PASS",
                  ifelse(results$status == "FAIL", "\u274c FAIL", "\u26a0\ufe0f ERROR"))

kable(
  results[, c("id","label","Result","detail")],
  col.names = c("ID", "Test label", "Result", "Detail"),
  align     = c("l","l","c","l"),
  caption   = "aed_alum stress test results"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-plot
#| echo: false

if (n_total > 0) {
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Status = c("PASS","FAIL","ERROR"),
    Count  = c(n_pass, n_fail, n_error)
  ) |> filter(Count > 0)

  print(
    ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Status)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.4) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(PASS  = "#4caf50",
                                   FAIL  = "#f44336",
                                   ERROR = "#ff9800")) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "aed_alum test summary",
           x = NULL, y = "Number of checks") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "right")
  )
}
```
